second_pass.summary: Agreed with both MAJORs and with both proposed replacements; added one MINOR (a dangling possessive in the two parked clauses); proposed one further MINOR that this audit rejects because it would reintroduce the doubled preposition the translator already fixed.
second_pass.severity_differences: The second pass argued that `head.next` should read `{head} · далее через {label}` on the premise that `{label}` is a bare duration ('далее 45s'). Executed, `{label}` is `due.ahead`'s output, already 'через 4m', so the proposed bytes render '3 пробуждения · далее через через 4m' — the exact defect the translator fixed and this audit's negative control reproduces. Rejected on evidence. Its would-be cure for cadence.left ('осталась #', inferred from this audit's wording) was also rejected by the second pass itself, which independently landed on core's uniform 'осталось #'.
accepted: RU-SCH-1 severity MAJOR, replacement '{cadence} · {remaining, plural, one {осталось #} few {осталось #} many {осталось #} other {осталось #}}'
RU-SCH-2 severity MAJOR, replacement '{count, plural, one {# активный} few {# активных} many {# активных} other {# активных}}'
RU-SCH-4 (new) MINOR, dangling 'её' in parked.monitors / parked.wakes
rejected: head.next -> '{head} · далее через {label}' (premise wrong: label already carries 'через'; would double the preposition)
second_pass.noted_not_filed: It suggested making sessions.live attributive ('# активная / # активных') for robustness. That key never renders 0 (sessionCountLabel returns the base at live <= 0), so this is a future-proofing note, not a defect at this head; recorded here, not filed as a finding.
second_pass.agreement: It independently confirmed the state.* gender mapping, the monitor-object term, the машина/компьютер split, 77/77 placeholder and ICU parity, all 11 plurals carrying one/few/many/other, and the вы register.

fit.method: AppKit NSFont.systemFont (the face iOS resolves for -apple-system) advance widths at text-meta 12/500, text-body-sm 14/400, text-heading 17/600 and text-mono-label 11/600 +0.06em, against the 320 pt narrow device minus Screen px-4 = 288 pt of content (schedule rows pl-3 = 276 pt; a badge pill px-2 = 272 pt), plus a greedy word wrap from the measured token advances. Slots read from the call sites, not assumed.
fit.result: No catalogue string in this group sits under a one-line clamp and overflows: the project row's meta line (projects.tsx:273, numberOfLines={1}) peaks at 215.8 pt of 288 for the audited shapes, and no unbreakable token in any string exceeds its slot. Median ru/en growth on the same key is 1.28x. Two strings wrap to 2 lines where English takes 1 at 320 pt: the parked clause (453.9 pt) and the truncated strip (294.3 pt); both are unclamped text. The stale badge renders 120.8 pt of a 272 pt pill, so it fits, but it leaves ~165 pt for the project name beside it (en: ~180 pt).
fit.hint_note: The native context schema has no maxCells field; the only 'Translator budget' notes in the repository are mobile.session_health.ended_placeholder and the two relay.health state words, none of them in this group.
